title.en: A cheaper quantum circuit is not a fusion breakthrough
title.zh: 量子电路成本降了，不等于聚变进度条拉满

claim.en: New Intelligence linked Gemini’s quantum-algorithm work to a dramatic leap in fusion progress.
claim.zh: 新智元把 Gemini 的量子算法改进写成聚变进度条拉满。

evidence.en: DeepMind reported an 11.8-fold reduction in a combined qubit-and-operation cost metric for one fusion-related computation. The team verified the algorithm mathematically, not by running the full circuit on current hardware.
evidence.zh: DeepMind 报告的是一项聚变相关计算的量子电路：由量子比特和操作数合成的成本指标降到原来的约 1/11.8。团队做的是数学验证，并没有用现有硬件跑完该电路。

takeaway.en: DeepMind says the proposed simulations would still exceed the likely resources of first-generation error-corrected quantum computers. The research improved a computational method, not a real fusion reactor.
takeaway.zh: DeepMind 指出，这类模拟仍可能超过第一代纠错量子计算机的资源上限。改进的是计算方法，不是现实里的聚变装置。

title.en: 24% was not the ceiling for agents
title.zh: 24% 不是 Agent 的能力上限

claim.en: New Intelligence framed the result as agents pretending to search, with just 24% accuracy.
claim.zh: 新智元用「假装搜索、仅 24% 准确率」概括这项 Agent 测试。

evidence.en: RDQA’s 24.0% was the best evidence-adjusted score among 12 generic configurations on 1,350 source-dependent questions. The authors’ process-aware baseline reached 41.1% on that same metric.
evidence.zh: 在 1,350 道必须查原始资料的 RDQA 题上，24.0% 是 12 套通用配置中最高的证据校验后准确率。同一指标下，论文的 RDQA-Skill 基线达到 41.1%。

takeaway.en: A correct answer without a verified trace is ungrounded by this benchmark’s definition. That does not establish that the model memorized the answer. Audit the source and the retrieval trace, not just the final answer.
takeaway.zh: 按论文的定义，答对但轨迹没证明查到指定材料，只能判定证据不达标，不能断定模型靠背。评估搜索时，答案和取证过程都要看。

title.en: A VP ≠ VNP claim does not settle P vs NP
title.zh: Claude 公布 VP≠VNP 证明，不等于解决 P vs NP

claim.en: New Intelligence described a Lean-checked result as the algebraic version of P ≠ NP.
claim.zh: 新智元把这项 Lean 核验成果称为「代数版 P≠NP」。

evidence.en: Anthropic released an AI-authored paper and Lean formalization claiming VP and VNP differ over every field. Its release notes say no human mathematician had checked the proof at publication and distinguish checking the formal theorem from matching it to the informal claim.
evidence.zh: Anthropic 发布了 AI 撰写的论文和 Lean 形式化证明，声称任意域上 VP 与 VNP 不相等。发布说明指出，发布时尚无人类数学家核查证明，Lean 通过与形式化命题准确对应论文主张是两回事。

takeaway.en: The claim concerns arithmetic circuits. Clay’s P vs NP problem concerns decision problems in Boolean computation and remains listed as unsolved.
takeaway.zh: 这项主张讨论算术电路。克雷研究所的 P vs NP 是关于布尔计算中判定问题的千禧难题，仍列为未解决。

title.en: 297 projects are not twice the scientific output
title.zh: 297 个项目立项，不等于科研产出翻倍

claim.en: New Intelligence’s anniversary coverage emphasized the global momentum of the US Genesis Mission.
claim.zh: 新智元在美国「创世纪」一周年报道里强调计划带来的全球热度。

evidence.en: The Department of Energy counts 297 selected projects involving 369 institutions. The mission’s stated goal is to double US research productivity and impact within a decade, not a measured year-one result.
evidence.zh: 美国能源部统计了 297 个获选项目，涉及 369 家机构。计划希望在十年内让美国科研生产率和影响力翻倍，不是说第一年实测已翻倍。

takeaway.en: Project selection measures activity, not outcomes. Look for comparable time-to-result, replication rates, and independently checked discoveries when assessing the program.
takeaway.zh: 立项数量衡量的是投入和活动。要评估产出，应等可比较的研究耗时、复现率和独立核验的发现。

title.en: A better bound is not a faster run
title.zh: 复杂度更好，不等于实测更快

claim.en: New Intelligence framed the Claude-assisted result as a first overturning of Dijkstra’s shortest-path algorithm.
claim.zh: 新智元把 Claude 参与的最短路成果写成「首次颠覆 Dijkstra」。

evidence.en: Vals reported a Lean-verified improvement in a specific edge-density regime. It did not report faster wall-clock performance on large graphs. Duan and colleagues had already beaten Dijkstra’s time bound for sparse directed graphs in 2025.
evidence.zh: Vals 披露的是特定边密度范围内经过 Lean 核验的渐近复杂度改进，没有给出大图上的实际速度优势。Duan 等人已在 2025 年对稀疏有向图打破过 Dijkstra 的时间上界。

takeaway.en: Credit the new bound. Before replacing a production algorithm, compare implementations on the graphs you run, including wall-clock time and memory.
takeaway.zh: 新上界是实打实的进展。真要替换生产算法，还得在自己的图上测运行时间和内存。

title.en: Reading an activation is not measuring experience
title.zh: 读到内部表征，不等于测到了主观体验

claim.en: New Intelligence’s headline asks whether Claude has consciousness after researchers found and could alter an internal representation.
claim.zh: 新智元以「Claude 有意识了？」引出一项可读取和干预内部表征的研究。

evidence.en: Anthropic observed that models could report and modulate certain internal signals, and that interventions affected performance on controlled tasks. The authors distinguish those functional findings from subjective experience.
evidence.zh: Anthropic 观察到模型能报告和调节某些内部信号；干预也影响了受控任务的表现。作者把这些功能发现与主观体验明确区分。

takeaway.en: This is evidence about how a model processes information. It does not answer whether there is anything it feels like to be that model.
takeaway.zh: 结果推进了对模型如何处理信息的理解，但并未回答模型有没有主观感受。

label.zh: Anthropic 原始研究及其局限

title.en: A Goldbach-type theorem is not the two-prime conjecture
title.zh: 证明了 Liouville 版本，不是两素数猜想

claim.en: New Intelligence described a GPT-6 Astra result as a significant Goldbach breakthrough.
claim.zh: 新智元把 GPT-6 Astra 参与的成果描述为哥德巴赫猜想的重大突破。

evidence.en: The formal statement represents an even integer above two as a sum of two integers, each with an odd number of prime factors counted with multiplicity. An integer such as 8 satisfies that condition without being prime.
evidence.zh: 形式化证明允许两个加数各自拥有奇数个素因子（计重数）。例如 8 有三个因子 2，满足条件，却不是素数。

takeaway.en: It is a theorem about a larger class of summands. The formal statement does not prove that the two summands can always be chosen to be prime.
takeaway.zh: 这是对一类更宽的加数成立的定理。它没有证明两个加数总能同时取素数。
